contexts.text: Be a master to thy brethren () = dominion...

In every house (in Heaven) there is a master and there are domestic servants; the master loves the servants, and the servants love the master; whence from love they serve each other mutually; the master teaches how men ought to live, and tells what is to be done; the servants obey, and perform their offices.
For the natural man is a servant, and the spiritual man is a master and lord.
A house (would fall to pieces) unless (it depended upon) one master.
In like manner... a servant is united to his master by doing those things which are agreeable to his will...
No upright master can deal so with his servants and maidservants.

The household duties of charity are those of... a master and a mistress towards their male and female domestic servants; and of the latter towards them... The duties of a master and mistress towards their male and female servants, partake of the love of reigning; and this of the state of each one's mind.
